column1: 545241 An artistic career rests on a craft (technique), an audience and an image. All three are built separately.
180ff1 Attributes, practice, style, fans by territory, social media, sponsorships and your team.
469a6c The catalog is a creator's estate: every work keeps generating income years after it is released.
1eea71 Project in progress, releases and the life of each work with its chart.
5d1bb1 Record labels, studios, publishers, agencies and imprints finance, distribute and promote in exchange for most of the income.
d1f405 Your contract, offers (with negotiation) and companies by size and prestige.
0f707d No career happens alone: you compete for attention with hundreds of peers and the charts turn over every week.
54ea66 Hit chart, ranking, peers, awards and news from your industry.
282b14 For many artists live shows bring in more money than recorded works; a tour is a business with enormous costs.
4ef35a One-off shows and tours; both with decision moments on screen.
baba27 The numbers of a career: works, hits, audience, awards and income over time.
b9837a Statistics, income per year, awards and retirement.
f6b4b8 Each discipline combines different skills: in music, voice and songwriting matter; in cooking, technique and palate.
aeb24b Your level is the weighted average. Each type of work uses two attributes and each live decision, one.
2459d2 Talent counts, but level is built with thousands of hours of focused practice, ideally with a good teacher.
b62950 Mainly raises the chosen attribute; it yields less the more you repeat it in the year and the closer you get to 100.
eb53c6 Genre defines who you compete with and which audience looks for you. Changing it is possible, but it confuses those who already followed you.
c89b6f It is your label in charts and rankings; you can change it whenever you want.
f9c70a A work goes through pre-production, working sessions, post-production and release. Quality is uneven: there are good days and bad days.
9a3ba7 Each session costs days and adds quality; when done, you choose the promotion and release it.
3e5b56 A bigger budget buys better equipment, studio and time, but it doesn't guarantee a hit.
ca356e Modest, professional or large-scale: raises quality by 0, 5 or 10%. With a contract, the company advances the cost and recoups it from your royalties.
44b917 Actors and models don't produce their own works: they compete for roles and campaigns. Most auditions end in a «no».
3718c2 Visible odds based on level, fame and representation. If you are chosen, you collect a fee and work the sessions.
8d54a2 Almost everything released peaks in the first weeks and then declines; a few works become classics.
49c08a Each work starts strong and fades at its own pace (a single fast, an album or a book more slowly).
58885f The advance is not a gift: it is a prepayment of your royalties. The company first takes back the advance and the costs; only then do you receive money («recouping»).
8f4d48 «Advance to recoup» goes down with what your works generate. When the contract ends, whatever wasn't recouped is absorbed by the company.
d8eb8f Independents give freedom and a better percentage; multinationals, money and worldwide distribution. Three or four groups control most of each industry.
34b046 The company's own reach is added to your audience on every release.
91feab The share of a work's income that goes to its creator. In recorded music it is around 15–25%; in books, 8–15%.
874e57 Your share of what your works generate each month.
e18ad6 As long as this balance exists, your royalties stay with the company.
5fe798 Includes the advance, production and promotion the company paid up front.
d6e76d Whoever has creative control decides the final content of the work. Big companies rarely grant it to new artists.
ae8ff3 With creative control your works gain a little quality.
7af5de Contracts are usually measured in works delivered, not just in years.
8ec927 If the contract ends and you still owe works, your image with the industry drops.
92e261 Payments arrive periodically according to the real consumption of your works.
e48ddc What your catalog earned you last month, after recouping advances.
c6443c Charts rank works by recent consumption (streams, box office, sales). Getting into the top 10 multiplies exposure.
c58005 The 20 most consumed works of the month; yours are highlighted.
ee99cb Besides works, people are measured too: total audience, box office, market value.
61e943 Sorted by audience. Your position appears even if you are outside the top 30.
201be2 Collaborations bring audiences together; rivalries generate attention but burn bridges.
656634 Hang out to raise the relationship; at 25 or more you can invite them to collaborate.
183004 Awards are voted by academies or juries from the trade itself; quality, campaigning and timing all weigh in.
951fde History of winners. If you are nominated, you live the ceremony on screen.
75fec1 A career's achievements are counted in works, hits, live audience and awards.
6371a2 They are updated every month.
0e8276 A professional footballer lives off performance: minutes, goals, ratings and the coach's trust define their value and future.
4b699d Attributes, overall, market value, contract, season, training and dressing room.
48c9d4 Clubs are businesses with a budget, a stadium and fans; their sporting strength usually follows their money.
79037a Your league table, last match, squad stars and honors.
6f5292 Clubs buy and sell players in the transfer windows (summer and winter). The selling club collects a transfer fee; the player negotiates wages and years.
6bf534 Transfer, loan or free-agent offers; your club decides whether to sell, unless they pay your release clause.
fcc944 Leagues, national cups, continental cups and national-team tournaments are all played at the same time during the year.
ae5558 Tables, groups, knockout rounds and history of champions.
502e20 Pace, technique, passing, shooting, defending, physical and, for goalkeepers, goalkeeping. Each position needs a different mix.
87c97a Your overall is the weighted average according to your position. A center back depends on defending; a striker, on shooting.
24ea96 What a club would pay for you today: it depends on your level, age, league and years left on your contract (with a year or less you are worth much less).
2d7ffe Basis for transfer fees and the wages you are offered.
7227e6 A fixed amount that, if another club pays it, forces your club to let you go (very common in Spain).
0096c5 If an offer matches it, your club cannot refuse.
b037ab Scouts estimate how far a young player can go; it's never certain.
cd847d Until age 23 you grow only according to your minutes; the stars show your natural ceiling.
a37789 The coach decides who plays. Performing well, training hard and not causing trouble builds trust.
3f3ee2 Goes up or down with your ratings and decisions; it defines your role.
33cad9 Players go through good and bad streaks.
a8a4c4 Recent average of your ratings; it improves your chances of playing.
6478a7 Statistics are counted per season: matches, minutes, goals, assists and average rating (from 1 to 10).
ba2b2f Your numbers are saved in your Career history at the end of each season.
e019a7 Relationships with the coach and teammates weigh as much as talent.
52039b Talk to the coach to ask for minutes (it can go badly).
209715 Each offer comes with a transfer fee (what they pay your club), wages, years and the role they promise you.
b62d6d You can negotiate wages or a starting spot with visible odds; asking too much can cancel the offer.
bda8ca The agent negotiates contracts and looks for clubs; they charge a commission.
fec17e Improves your odds when negotiating.
fb988f A footballer's career is counted in seasons, clubs and titles.
152947 Your seasons, the national team and your trophies.
38646d National teams play qualifiers, FIFA dates and tournaments; the World Cup is the biggest event in the sport.
954b28 Tournaments in progress and national-team ranking by strength.
26d226 Each league plays a round robin; in Mexico, two short tournaments with playoffs. In many leagues the bottom teams are relegated.
ab52cd League table, latest matchday, playoffs and top scorers.
e9a2a0 A professional fighter is a small business: they have a trainer, a manager, a promoter, a medical team and a record that defines their value.
e390fa Your attributes, accumulated damage, record, gym, promoter, fans and your next fight.

80cf6f In boxing there are several sanctioning bodies that recognize champions (that's why there are several "world champions" in the same division). Specialized magazines and websites also publish an independent ranking.
88f2e1 The consolidated world ranking mixes quality and results; each body has its own ranking and champion. A body's number 1 is the mandatory challenger.
c6078c A fighter's career is counted in their record, their titles and their people: promoter, manager and trainer.
1bad47 Promoter contract, manager, gyms, division change, fight history and amateur medals.
9f0338 Professionals don't pick just any opponent: the promoter negotiates fights that suit their career and their business.
7507d1 Look for fights, review offers and negotiate the purse.
cb4d81 Power, speed, defense, stamina (cardio), chin (taking punches) and technique (ring IQ). In MMA wrestling (takedowns and control) and submissions (locks and chokes) also count.
668a4a Each attribute weighs in the simulation of every round. The chin is almost entirely natural and accumulated damage keeps wearing it down.
1043b8 Repeated blows to the head damage the brain permanently (chronic traumatic encephalopathy). That's why commissions impose medical suspensions after a knockout.
438ee1 Rises with every hard fight, every knockdown and sparring. It reduces your chin and your health. More than 12 is worrying; more than 20, serious.
058518 A system that measures relative strength based on results: beating someone better raises it a lot; losing to someone worse lowers it a lot.
019299 Part of your place in the rankings.
9966fa Camps are planned in blocks: strength and power, speed, technique, cardio. Each fighter works on their weaknesses and sharpens their weapons.
ff5d85 The chosen attribute rises a lot and the others a little. The gym's specialty adds 30%. Near 100 each point costs more.
874145 A practice fight with headgear and big gloves. It's where you really learn, but also where you build up a lot of career damage.
63cb56 Raises technique and defense according to the level of your gym mates; it adds a little accumulated damage.
4c5f69 Short bouts (3 rounds) won on points; the referee stops the fight as soon as a fighter is in danger. It's the school of almost every champion.
a88475 Raises your amateur record and your technique; with 4 wins you can enter the national championship.
2b6269 Fights are single elimination: whoever loses is out. In Olympic boxing both semifinal losers receive bronze.
b3b89f Medals, fans and interest from promoters. The national opens the continental and the world championship; the Olympic Games are every four years.
8efa71 When turning pro, a fighter starts earning purses and leaves Olympic boxing. Amateur medals are worth a lot when negotiating the first contract.
053581 You receive offers from promoters based on your amateur record.
35f0c6 The promoter calls other promoters to lock in opponents, dates and venues; without a promoter, a fighter depends on small shows.
c9e0e5 Generates fight offers. With a promoter they come more often and pay better.
3246c5 Every fight is negotiated: opponent, date, rounds, venue, place on the card and the purse (what each fighter earns).
4f06b8 Tune-up fight (weaker opponent), one at your level, a step-up (better opponent) or for the title. You can negotiate before signing.
aa8792 Between signing and the fight there is a camp of 6 to 12 weeks.
817346 Hire your corner team and choose your game plan. On fight day the clock stops.
2fe8a3 The cutman closes cuts between rounds; the strength coach builds cardio; the nutritionist guides the weight cut to make the limit without losing strength.
f905f4 Each one has a cost per fight and an effect on fight night.
b3f703 "Styles make fights": each style has an advantage over some and a disadvantage against others.
46da77 Sets volume, accuracy, defense, power and energy use in each round. Between rounds you can change it from the corner.
44c8fe The promoter organizes the events, pays the purses, negotiates with television and decides who you face. Contracts guarantee a number of fights per year.
dd98a0 More fights, better purses and access to titles according to their level (local, national, global). Breaking a contract costs a penalty.
6f7b47 Represents the fighter before promoters and takes between 10 and 33% of their purses.
6bbc58 Takes their commission and improves your odds when negotiating.
a81bf6 The gym defines your trainer, your sparring and your method. Changing teams takes months to build chemistry.
8b345e Training effectiveness, sparring quality, specialty and cost; from neighborhood level up, the trainer takes 10% of your purses.
e97869 Fighters compete by weight so the fight is fair. Many dehydrate to make weight the day before and rehydrate for the fight.
537484 Moving up gives power and bigger opponents; moving down gives speed and a riskier weight cut.
724e20 Each body recognizes one champion per division; whoever holds all four belts is undisputed champion.
96666e Current champions of each division and body (or league in MMA).
c92f04 A record is written wins-losses-draws; knockouts tell how hard a fighter hits.
9f4002 All your fights with method, round, title, venue and purse.
f32960 Each share is a small piece of ownership of a company: it entitles you to a portion of its profits (dividends) and to vote at the shareholders' meeting.
a041e9 Number of shares you hold in this company.
15dfe2 What you do with your free time: study, exercise, socialize, have fun. In real life, time is the scarcest resource: nobody can buy more than 24 hours a day.
34ebfc Every action spends days of your free time (about 120 a year, 40 in prison). Repeating the same thing within the year yields less and less (diminishing returns), so it pays to vary.

0b3cb4 Your job defines your income, your network and your status. Careers with promotions (politics, military, business, finance, government) reward seniority and performance; fame careers reward talent, consistency and luck.
348ef3 Here you choose university, jobs, careers toward power and fame careers (⭐). Each position has requirements (age, education, intelligence, influence).
f1b327 A country is a territory with a government, an economy, an army and relations with other countries. As a citizen you affect it little; as a ruler you decide taxes, spending, laws and wars.
a3dba5 Shows your country's data. If you rule, the government actions are here; they use up mandate points and sometimes need congressional approval.
b8f992 Everything else in your life: family, assets, finances, banks, stock market, companies, news and settings.
a7f0f7 Menu with the rest of the screens. The bottom bar is always visible: you can jump between Actions, Career, Nation and More without closing anything.
580e6e Time brings compound interest, inflation, aging and opportunities. Small decisions repeated over years are what change a life the most.

b2f63e Advances the unit chosen on the clock (day, week, month, year or 5 years). The economy and war are calculated at the close of each month and each year; the clock stops by itself only before important decisions.
be26f5 Your individual life: health, money, family, career.
d5322c Shows your life, your stats and the log of what happens to you.
39502b The statesman's view: a country seen as a whole, with its economy, its people, its army and its diplomacy.
06f29a Tabs with everything about your country. It works even if you don't rule: it helps you understand the context that affects your life (inflation, unemployment, wars).
37a436 Depends on genetics, habits (diet, exercise, sleep, alcohol, tobacco), access to doctors and stress. It is the basis of everything: without health you can neither work nor enjoy life.
176819 If it reaches 0 you die. It goes down with age, illness and fights; it goes up with exercise, the doctor and good habits. It counts for sports and physical jobs.
0dcee8 Studies (for example Harvard's study of adult development, which has followed people for more than 80 years) show that close relationships matter more than money, once basic needs are covered.
d86d06 Goes up with relationships, achievements and free time; goes down with debts, losses and loneliness. Very low happiness triggers crises and bad decisions.
de23ed A mix of innate ability and accumulated learning. Education remains one of the investments with the best long-term return.
cffe79 Required for careers, university and promotions. It goes up by studying and reading. It is the key attribute for creators, comedians, writers, chefs and DJs.
86e0ac How others perceive you. It influences (though it shouldn't) hiring and salaries, and it is central in modeling, acting and music.
be47b9 Goes up with exercise, self-care and services such as a trainer. It is the key attribute for music, acting and modeling.
19f8ef Your social and political capital: who you know and who listens to you. It opens doors that money alone doesn't.
33840b Needed to rise in politics, the military and business, and to stage coups. It goes up with positions, networking, fame and public relations.
7a7424 What you have left after taxes and fixed expenses. It is what you can really save or invest.
8a85f0 The bar compares your income with the average wage of your region.
9909db Everything you own (cash, home, investments, companies) minus everything you owe. It is the real measure of wealth, more than salary.
c1205c Determines which banks you can access (private banking), how much credit you get and your inheritance.
a597b9 Borrowed money you must pay back with interest. Used well (a home, education, a profitable business) it accelerates you; used badly (consumption) it makes you poorer.
ece881 If you don't pay, your credit history drops and your property can be seized. Check More → Finances and Banks.
28f91d A country's big numbers: population, GDP (everything it produces in a year), growth, inflation and stability.
23ea97 Quick view of your country and who rules it.
261285 The internal divisions of a country (states, provinces, departments). Each one has its own economy and population.
846fe6 List and map of provinces with population, wealth, development and buildings. If you rule you can build projects in them.
11b02b The armed forces: personnel, equipment and budget. World military spending is around 2% of global GDP; keeping a large army is expensive in peacetime.
293043 Your armies, their size, morale and quality. Recruiting costs money and population; terrain and generals change battles.
cd08a3 How a country produces, spends and trades: GDP, inflation, unemployment, debt, currency, central bank, banks and reserves.
080283 Your country's economic data and, if you rule, the levers: taxes, spending, monetary policy, reserves and the financial system.
2d7c66 Relations between countries: alliances, trade treaties, sanctions and rivalries. Most international politics is decided by negotiating, not fighting.
2405f4 Relations with each country. Improve relations, sign treaties, form alliances or declare war.
a9c55f Armed conflict between countries. Besides lives, it costs GDP, debt and stability; long wars usually end in negotiation.
67fcba Fronts, battles and morale. A front of ±100 lets you take provinces; the peace conference divides territory.
07a36d Comparison of countries by economic and military power. Powers change over the decades: growth, demographics and technology.
07ad98 Your place in the world and the military powers.
ee7c6e Ministries carry out policy: Finance, Health, Education, Defense, Energy... The president appoints their heads and gives them a budget.
683c37 Each ministry has a head, a competence score and a budget. If you rule you appoint ministers and give directives; if you are a minister, you run your portfolio.
66fdfb Democracy, monarchy, dictatorship, one-party state... It defines how power is chosen, how long it lasts and what limits it has.
27f9ea Changes how you reach power, whether there are elections and how much support you need in congress.
620a3c What the government collects (taxes, natural resources) and spends (health, education, defense, debt). Spending more than comes in creates deficits and debt.
795394 The government's yearly income and spending. An empty treasury forces you to borrow, print money or cut.
c07e84 Agreements signed between countries: trade, defense, non-aggression. They reduce uncertainty and make exchange easier.
bccf78 Your country's active treaties and the years they have left.
3402aa The countries with the greatest military capacity, measured by personnel, budget and technology.
3ac3d7 Comparison of world military power.
8906ab Throughout history countries have unified (Germany in 1871, Italy in 1861) and others have split apart.
cdc99b If you control certain provinces you can proclaim a new nation.

2a0696 The central bank controls the amount of money and the benchmark interest rate. It raises the rate to curb inflation (credit gets more expensive) and lowers it to stimulate the economy. Many follow the Taylor rule.
4cbae2 Your currency, exchange rate, exchange-rate regime and interest rate. If you rule you can devalue, fix the exchange rate, print money or carry out a monetary reform.
bfdca8 Each country uses its own currency (or adopts another, like the dollar in Ecuador). Its value depends on inflation, interest rates and confidence.
96de9e Your money is in the local currency; if it is devalued, everything imported gets more expensive.
5411ea The rate at which the central bank lends to banks. Mortgage, loan and savings rates depend on it.
c35a82 Rises with inflation. High rates: saving pays more and borrowing costs more.

9c1dfd The general rise in prices. Inflation of 2–3% a year is considered healthy; if it exceeds 50% a month it is called hyperinflation (Zimbabwe 2008, Venezuela 2018). It eats away the value of cash.
e2ba61 It erodes your cash and your wages if they are not adjusted. Protecting your money in real assets or in banks with a good rate is key.

8c6fc4 Floating: the market sets the currency's price. Fixed: the central bank holds it with reserves. Currency board: every banknote is backed by foreign currency. Fixed rates give stability, but they can suffer speculative attacks.
